findings.entity: mirror reflection of dancer's raised right arm
findings.description: During the first arm raise (00:00.50-00:01.50) the reflected right arm trails the real arm by roughly 0.2-0.25 s: at 00:01.00 the subject's arm is ~35-40 deg above horizontal with the wrist above head height while the reflection's arm is near shoulder level (~5-10 deg); at 00:01.25 subject ~40 deg vs reflection ~15 deg; at 00:01.50 subject ~65 deg vs reflection ~45 deg. The reflection reaches each angle about one sample later. Viewing geometry does not explain it: in the second, near-identical arm raise (00:06.25-00:06.75), from essentially the same camera angle, subject and reflection angles match frame for frame. Confirmed on sharp frames at 12 fps.
